function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH bowler_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler AS player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bb.ball_id) AS balls_bowled,
        SUM(bb.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded,
        COUNT(CASE 
            WHEN wt.kind_out IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'hit wicket', 'obstructing the field') 
            THEN 1 
        END) AS wickets_taken
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler AS player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        bb.wickets_taken,
        bb.runs_conceded
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            bb.bowler,
            bb.match_id,
            COUNT(DISTINCT wt.ball_id) AS wickets_taken,
            SUM(COALESCE(bb.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_conceded
        FROM ball_by_ball bb
        LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id
        LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
        WHERE wt.kind_out IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'hit wicket', 'obstructing the field')
        GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
    ) bb
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bb.bowler ORDER BY bb.wickets_taken DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    bs.player_id,
    bs.balls_bowled,
    bs.runs_conceded,
    bs.wickets_taken,
    CAST(1.0 * bs.runs_conceded / (bs.balls_bowled / 6.0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS economy_rate,
    CASE WHEN bs.wickets_taken > 0 THEN CAST(1.0 * bs.balls_bowled / bs.wickets_taken AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ELSE NULL END AS strike_rate,
    bb.match_id,
    bb.wickets_taken AS best_bowling_wickets,
    bb.runs_conceded AS best_bowling_runs
FROM bowler_stats bs
LEFT JOIN best_bowling bb ON bs.player_id = bb.player_id
ORDER BY bs.player_id", "preview_rows": 20}

WITH bowler_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler AS player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bb.ball_id) AS balls_bowled,
        SUM(bb.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded,
        COUNT(CASE 
            WHEN wt.kind_out IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'hit wicket', 'obstructing the field') 
            THEN 1 
        END) AS wickets_taken
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler AS player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        bb.wickets_taken,
        bb.runs_conceded
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            bb.bowler,
            bb.match_id,
            COUNT(DISTINCT wt.ball_id) AS wickets_taken,
            SUM(COALESCE(bb.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_conceded
        FROM ball_by_ball bb
        LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id
        LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
        WHERE wt.kind_out IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'hit wicket', 'obstructing the field')
        GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
    ) bb
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bb.bowler ORDER BY bb.wickets_taken DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    bs.player_id,
    bs.balls_bowled,
    bs.runs_conceded,
    bs.wickets_taken,
    CAST(1.0 * bs.runs_conceded / (bs.balls_bowled / 6.0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS economy_rate,
    CASE WHEN bs.wickets_taken > 0 THEN CAST(1.0 * bs.balls_bowled / bs.wickets_taken AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ELSE NULL END AS strike_rate,
    bb.match_id,
    bb.wickets_taken AS best_bowling_wickets,
    bb.runs_conceded AS best_bowling_runs
FROM bowler_stats bs
LEFT JOIN best_bowling bb ON bs.player_id = bb.player_id
ORDER BY bs.player_id
